caption:
counted my pickups for 3 days straight. average was 112. then counted how many times i actually sat with my feelings. zero.
so i made one change. my phone asks me to write one thought before it unlocks. takes 90 seconds. and suddenly i'm not reaching for it every 6 minutes anymore.

#screentime #phonetok #journaling #mentalhealth #digitalwellbeing

she walked in on me journaling out loud to my locked screen. asked if i was okay. showed her my 18-day streak.
now she sets alarms so she doesn’t forget 💀

#journaling #screentime #digitaldetox #nightroutine #roommates

i counted my pickups for a week. average was 112 a day. never once opened a journal. never sat with myself. so i made my phone ask me one question before it unlocks. takes 90 seconds. feels like the first honest thing i’ve done all year.

#screentime #phonetok #journaling #mentalhealth #selfcare

i counted. 118 pickups yesterday. couldn’t name a single real reason. so i made my phone ask me one question before it unlocks. takes 90 seconds to answer. that’s it.

i don’t even check it the same way anymore.

#screentime #phonetok #journaling #mentalhealth #digitalwellbeing

so i made one small change to my morning routine.

my phone locks until i write something down. anything. takes 90 seconds.

i don’t even recognize my pickup count anymore.
